card.title: Late delivery increases by service lane
card.what_to_watch: Late delivery counts in the immediately preceding closed week versus the current closed week for non-duplicate shipments with a delivery timestamp, including the total delta and each service-lane contribution.
card.why_watch: Identify material increases in late deliveries and route comparisons that do not satisfy the source comparability requirements.
watch_for: The source confirms the same shipment population after duplicate removal, the same late-delivery definition, adjacent closed periods, a complete disjoint service-lane partition, and reconciled totals.

numeric_conditions.text: Total current minus baseline late deliveries is at least 17 deliveries.
At least one service lane's current-minus-baseline contribution is at least 11 deliveries.

card.decision_guidance: Use late deliveries in adjacent closed weeks for the same shipment population after duplicate removal. Notify Fleet Operations when the total is at least 17 higher than baseline or when any service lane is at least 11 higher than its baseline. Compare current minus baseline; a negative lane contribution is not an increase. Use the result only when the source confirms the same population, definition, adjacent periods, complete lane partition, and reconciled totals. Route incomplete comparisons as insufficient_data to Logistics Data. If neither threshold is met, ignore. Describe lane contributions as accounting decomposition, not causes.
card.follow_up_guidance: Describe lane contributions as accounting decomposition, not causes. Do not infer causation from the comparison.

card.title: Monitor weighted customer recontact quality
card.what_to_watch: Weighted customer recontact rate across eligible support conversations by support channel, using conversation counts rather than an average of channel percentages.
card.why_watch: Identify when the weighted current rate or its change from the adjacent closed week requires Support Quality attention, while routing incomplete comparisons to Support Data.
watch_for: The source confirms the same population and definition across adjacent closed weeks, a complete disjoint channel partition, and reconciled totals.

numeric_conditions.text: Weighted current customer recontact rate is at least 9%.
Weighted current minus baseline customer recontact rate is at least 2.5 percentage points.

card.decision_guidance: Notify Support Quality when either numeric threshold is met. Route incomplete or non-comparable adjacent-week comparisons as insufficient_data to Support Data. If the source is complete and comparable and neither threshold is met, ignore. Describe channel accounting effects without claiming causes; contribution decomposition is not causal evidence.
card.follow_up_guidance: Use adjacent closed weeks and report the weighted totals, signed change, channel accounting contributions, and completeness/comparability status. Do not claim causes from the decomposition.

card.title: Signed contract-value movement by customer change type
card.what_to_watch: Monitor signed monthly contract-value movement from effective account-change records for the same billed-account population, comparing the current closed month with the immediately preceding closed month.
card.why_watch: Detect material deterioration in net contract-value movement or in exact contraction or churn contributions while preserving signed values and the owner's exception policy.
watch_for: The reporting source confirms the same billed-account population, signed-contract-movement definition, adjacent closed monthly periods, complete disjoint change-type partition, and reconciled totals.
The service-credit exception register resolves whether an approved exception covers the exact closed month.

numeric_conditions.text: Net signed contract-value movement is at least $75 lower than baseline (current minus baseline <= -75 USD).
The contraction contribution is at least $45 lower than baseline (signed contribution <= -45 USD).
The churn contribution is at least $45 lower than baseline (signed contribution <= -45 USD).

card.decision_guidance: Use the complete analytical report and resolved exception context. Preserve signs and compare current minus baseline. If a numeric trigger is present and an approved service-credit exception covers the exact closed month, ignore. If a numeric trigger is present and that exception context is unresolved, investigate with Commercial Data. If the report is partial or otherwise incomplete, return insufficient_data and route to Commercial Data. If the complete report has no numeric trigger, ignore. If a complete report has a trigger without an approved exception, notify Commercial Operations. Contributions describe measured movement, not causes.
card.follow_up_guidance: Report the signed baseline, current value, delta, triggered threshold(s), exact segment contributions, population and comparability checks, and exception status. Do not infer causal mechanisms from contribution breakdowns.
